response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff Software Engineer with excellent mentoring skills, a strong grasp of software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD), and solid distributed systems experience. However, he falls significantly short of the core minimum qualification of 8 years of C++ programming, possessing only a few months of professional C++ experience. His background leans heavily toward full-stack web, Node.js, and DLang rather than the deep internal cloud compute and hardware architecture required for this specific role.
strengths: Demonstrated technical leadership and extensive mentoring experience, including organizing workshops, Dojos, and courses.
Strong commitment to engineering best practices, including TDD, CI/CD, and trunk-based development.
Experience building high-throughput distributed systems and microservices handling millions of requests per second.
concerns: Critically lacks the minimum requirement of 8 years of C++ programming experience, with only ~7 months of professional C++ listed.
Background leans heavily toward full-stack web and product engineering rather than low-level cloud compute infrastructure.
Lacks deep, dedicated experience leading technical strategy specifically for internal cloud compute platforms.
